title: SET THE NAME OF ONE OR MORE MAPS IN A FILE
description: Sets the name of one or more maps for metric, shape, label, volume, cifti scalar or cifti label files.  You must specify either -name-file, or -from-data-file, or at least one -map option.  The three option types are mutually exclusive.

data_file.description: the file to set the map names of

name_file.description: use a text file to replace all map names

from_data_file.description: use the map names from another data file

index.description: the map index to change the name of

new_name.description: the name to set for the map

map.description: specify a map to set the name of
